notes: Deadly Riposte (FDN) is an INSTANT and 'target tapped creature' includes an attacker, which taps as it attacks (no vigilance). Seat 1 (the active player) attacks seat 0 with a 3/3 Ape; after attackers are declared seat 0 taps its two Plains and casts Deadly Riposte on the tapped Ape: it takes 3 and dies before blocks and damage, so seat 0 gains 2 and takes no combat damage (20 + 2 = 22).
